people.name: Jehoshaphat
people.line: Son of Asa, king of Judah.

translations.web: Jehoshaphat grew great exceedingly; and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah.
translations.bsb: Jehoshaphat grew stronger and stronger, and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah
translations.kjv: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Judah castles, and cities of store.
translations.asv: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Judah castles and cities of store.
